text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: db-proxy-prod connections above threshold (95% of pool used). PD: P12345. Auto-escalation in 4m if not acked.
Priya: acked — I'm on it. grabbing runbook.
PagerDuty: auto-ack from Priya (on-call). escalation timer paused.
Priya: quick check — metrics look like connection_count spiking on pgbouncer frontends across us-east-1. 95%+ client connections, 85% server connections.
Jorge: seeing large burst of short-lived spikes from the web tier — likely a retry storm. @Priya any traffic shape changes?
Priya: not from product side AFAIK. checking deploys. nothing in last 30m. adding pgbouncer logs: ```pgbouncer: auth timeout, new connections queued, total_clients=2400, max_clients=2500```
Nora: possible leak in background worker loops too. Can we temporarily increase pgbouncer max_client to buy time?
Priya: changing max_clients is lower-risk than DB scale-up. Will bump from 2500 -> 3200 on the pool group for web-prod. Doing canary on 2 hosts.
Jorge: also enabling connection_mtx_debug to see if accept queue persists.
Priya: ran command (ops CLI): `infra pgbouncer set --pool web-prod --max-clients 3200 --reason "emergency surge"`
incident-bot: Deploybot: change applied to 2/6 pgbouncer hosts. Monitoring..
Priya: Canary looks okay, no auth errors. client queue depth dropped 40% on those hosts. rolling to rest.
PagerDuty: PD note: P12345 now acknowledged by Priya; handoff timer reset.
Nora: adding quick routing rule: divert 20% of read-only traffic to read-replica cluster (ro-us-east) to reduce server-side connections. Command: `trafficctl route add --service web-read --percent 20 --target ro-us-east`
Jorge: good. also increasing DB connection pool size on service instances to avoid repeated reconnects (env var SERVICE_DB_MAX=50 -> 80) and rolling them. Note: this increases server connections; we rely on read routing to offset.
Priya: checking customer impact: latency spike seen for ~7% of requests, error rate 0.3% (mostly 502 from pgbouncer accept queue). No major customer-facing incidents reported via support yet.
Nora: posting status to #general: "DB proxy surge—mitigations in progress; temporary config changes; minimal customer impact" :warning:
Jorge: observing retry patterns from job-runner cluster — throttling their workers by adding `JOB_PARALLELISM=4` to limit bursts.
Priya: changes rolled. overall connection usage down to 72% across pool, server connections trending down.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: auto-escalation cancelled.
Priya: transitioning to monitoring-only. will leave the config changes in place for 30m then roll back if stable.
Nora: leaving handoff note: "Mitigations: pgbouncer max_clients increased to 3200, 20% read traffic routed to ro-us-east, web services rolled with SERVICE_DB_MAX=80, job-runner parallelism reduced. No customer-facing outage. Follow-up: investigate retry storm source and add circuit breaker on client side"
PagerDuty: closing PD incident P12345 (resolved).
Priya: closing thread — will create follow-up ticket with perf traces and link to runbook edits. :white_check_mark:
